channel.title: Market Pressure Map · Indian markets
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Indian market sectors and the rupee, bonds, inflation and foreign flows.

item.title: RBI raises repo rate 25 bps to 5.50%, first hike since 2023; stance shifts to 'calibrated tightening'
item.description:
The MPC voted unanimously for the hike; four of six backed the tighter stance. FY27 inflation forecast raised to 5.2% from 5.0%; growth forecast raised to 7.1% from 6.7%. Expected all week; the tighter stance signals more may follow.

Why it matters: Higher policy rates lift loan costs for homes, vehicles and businesses and push bond yields up; a tightening bias keeps that pressure on, while a stronger growth forecast cushions earnings.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: 10-year G-Sec yield jumps to 7.27% after the hike, up 8 bps from 7.19%, a 2.5-year high
item.description:
Yields rose after the decision, extending a climb of 24 bps in September and 44 bps last quarter. Escalating.

Why it matters: Higher government bond yields raise borrowing costs across the economy and cut the value of banks' bond holdings.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: Sensex slips 296 points after the hike, ending a two-day rally; auto and realty stocks lead losses
item.description:
The Sensex fell to 72,771.86 by mid-morning after rising 685 points to 73,067.81 on Tuesday. The auto index fell 1.16% and realty 0.65%, while banks dipped only 0.18%. Reverses the two-day rebound.

Why it matters: Rate-sensitive sectors reprice for dearer loans; banks hold up better on wider margins.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: Foreign investors sell ₹2,961 crore on Tuesday; domestic funds buy ₹5,089 crore
item.description:
Foreign investors were net sellers for a third straight session and held a large net short in index futures, while domestic institutions kept buying. Ongoing.

Why it matters: Domestic buying cushions the market, but steady foreign selling pressures index heavyweights and the rupee.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −2, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: days

item.title: Rupee weakens to about 96.6 per dollar around the RBI decision
item.description:
The rupee fell 10 paise to 96.45 before the decision and the dollar rose to about 96.60 after it, despite the hike. The RBI said it will curb excessive volatility. Ongoing weakness.

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises import costs and imported inflation while lifting IT and pharma exporters' earnings; the hike's support was outweighed by oil and outflows.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: Brent rises 0.9% to $101.51 on Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and a US Gulf storm
item.description:
Houthi attacks hit two Saudi airports and a storm threatens US Gulf output, about 15% of US crude. US crude stocks fell 2.09 million barrels. Escalating despite higher Middle East exports.

Why it matters: Crude above $100 widens India's import bill, keeps fuel inflation and rupee pressure high, and squeezes airlines and fuel marketers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: Ship hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz; 11 Indian sailors among 12 injured
item.description:
A Panama-flagged vessel was struck off Oman; injured crew were evacuated to Oman. India condemned the attack and called for an immediate halt. Crew risk pay is pushing freight rates up. Escalating.

Why it matters: Attacks on India's main oil route keep war-risk insurance and freight costs high and raise the cost of delivered crude.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: Drone strike sets Russian-linked oil tanker ablaze near Sochi; all 23 Indian crew rescued
item.description:
Ukrainian naval drones hit a tanker linked to Russia's shadow fleet off Sochi; all 23 Indian crew were rescued. Kyiv called India's three-part truce plan, covering energy sites and Black Sea shipping, the broadest of four. Escalating.

Why it matters: Strikes on Russian oil shipping raise risk to discounted crude flows and to Indian crews; a truce would ease Black Sea grain, fertiliser and energy risk.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks

item.title: GST Council meets today on process reforms, export relief for services and easing prosecution rules
item.description:
Proposals include treating some services to overseas entities as exports, faster refunds, and raising the prosecution threshold from ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore. No rate changes expected; decisions pending. Ongoing.

Why it matters: Export treatment for services to overseas affiliates would free input-tax credit for IT and capability centres; faster refunds ease working capital for manufacturers.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
